reserveReview.rationale: The BUIDL live-reserve producer is the single-asset chronicle-nav adapter: it reads the Chronicle Proof-of-Asset VAO consumer 0x2d6db2116aD7a6e203E72C8DCCfFf23f5315b0Dd via readWithAge() (value + age; probed 2026-09-09 at 1.00e18 NAV with age 2026-09-09T05:02:59Z, the dashboard's latest Oracle Updated event) and publishes exactly one exposure naming the fund share, so the reviewed row carries that producer identity at 100%. Chronicle's daily independently verified holdings table identifies all 18 look-through positions at its 2026-08-27T06:16:23Z source timestamp: five tri-party repo positions totaling $2.1355 billion and thirteen U.S. Treasury bills totaling $644.290777 million, against the reported $2,779,790,777 aggregate portfolio market value. The latest stated Treasury-bill maturity is 2026-11-12, 77 days after the composition date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle Proof of Asset NAV captured by the production chronicle-nav single-asset adapter (one 100% fund-share exposure), with the reviewed look-through position summary above
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified position remains in the dated holdings table; the live adapter itself publishes only the aggregate fund-share NAV, not position-level composition. The public sources still do not disclose a token-holder loss waterfall or the confidential offering memorandum; Pharos does not turn the displayed gross market value and outstanding-share figures into a contractual collateralization ratio.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer-authored Arbitrum STEP application (2024-05-04) states BNY Mellon is the Fund's administrator and custodian and that the Fund's assets are held in one or more accounts in the name of the Fund, with subcustodians and depositories permitted; no other fund-level custodian is named in reviewed sources, so the documented custody is a single-provider concentration. rwa.xyz (2026-07-16) lists the account segregation as bankruptcy remote. Sub-custodian splits and rehypothecation restrictions are not stated in reviewed public sources.
